name: Squire
concept_ja: 塩に曇った小盾を磨く、まだ装備の揃わない若い従士。強さの誇示より、守る準備の丁寧さを描く。
subject_en: One young adult woman with a freckled round face, two short auburn braids and an attentive expression, shown waist-up polishing a modest blue-steel buckler held against her chest. A short weathered ivory training surcoat covers practical leather padding; a distinctive ivory cord tied in a square knot fastens the buckler strap. Compact triangular silhouette, face and buckler together within the central seventy percent, visible working hands.
silhouette_ja: 短い二つ編み、狭い肩、胸の丸盾でつくる小さな三角形。
motif_ja: 磨き途中の丸盾、四角結びの象牙色の紐、擦れた革。
background_en: A quiet equipment alcove inside the Drowned Archive, green-black stone, one shallow shield-shaped recess and dim seafoam light reflected from distant water; keep the background soft and empty.
continuity_ja: Knightの青鋼・象牙・盾型アーチを最も簡素に扱う。四角結びの紐は合成先のKnight Champion（8）に引き継ぐ。

name: Guard
concept_ja: 潮風の入る書庫門を守る実務的な衛兵。使い込まれた装備と動かない姿勢で、従士とは異なる安定感を出す。
subject_en: One broad middle-aged man with a shaved head, a square weathered face and a short salt-and-pepper beard, shown chest-up with one gauntlet resting across the top of a tall blue-steel shield. The shield has a simple brass arch running around its upper rim and a single repaired corner. A heavy slate-blue collar and ivory shoulder cloth create a grounded rectangular silhouette; face, hand and upper shield remain centered.
silhouette_ja: 角張った頭、水平な肩、縦長の盾による幅広い長方形。
motif_ja: 真鍮のアーチを持つ大盾、角の修理跡、厚い肩布。
background_en: The inner side of a coastal archive gate, wet green-black masonry and a narrow slit of pale storm light; a blurred iron latch is the only secondary detail.
continuity_ja: Knightの防衛職を生活感で表現する。大盾の真鍮アーチと修理跡をKnight Champion（8）の装備に継承する。

name: Soldier
concept_ja: 海霧の巡回から戻った痩身の兵士。動きの残る斜めの姿勢で、門に立つGuardと見分けられるようにする。
subject_en: One lean older man with deep-set eyes, a long narrow face and close-cropped grey hair, shown waist-up turning toward the viewer while tightening the strap of a plain blue-steel shoulder plate. A short spear shaft crosses behind one shoulder, with its small spearhead kept within the upper crop. His rain-dark ivory scarf lifts slightly in the sea wind, forming a clear diagonal through an otherwise spare practical uniform.
silhouette_ja: 細い顔、片上がりの肩、短槍と襟布の斜線。
motif_ja: 雨に濡れた肩当て、締め直す革帯、細い短槍。
background_en: A covered passage along the Drowned Archive sea wall, dark stone fading into fog and one out-of-focus brass wall hook; no other soldiers.
continuity_ja: 青鋼と象牙色を維持しつつ、Knight共通の盾形を肩当ての輪郭だけに抑える。特殊な攻撃属性や能力の紋章は描かない。

name: Paladin
concept_ja: 日々の守備を務める静かな誓約の騎士。派手な聖光ではなく、整えられた装備と穏やかな目線に品位を持たせる。
subject_en: One mature woman with warm brown skin, silver hair braided close around her head and a calm direct gaze, shown waist-up fastening a worn ivory mantle over restrained blue-steel armor. A small closed oath case hangs at her sternum on an aged brass chain. Her hands meet at the mantle clasp, creating a clear centered diamond; the armor is plain and carefully maintained rather than royal.
silhouette_ja: 頭に沿う編み髪、左右に広がる短いマント、胸元で合う手の菱形。
motif_ja: 閉じた誓約筒、整えた象牙色のマント、盾形の留め金。
background_en: A small oath alcove in the coastal library, green-black stone, an empty brass lamp niche and a gentle ivory reflection; quiet architectural light, no magical halo.
continuity_ja: Commonとして装飾量は抑える。Knightの誓約という視覚的テーマを用い、回復など未実装の能力を示唆しない。

name: Sacrificial Squire
concept_ja: 従士が自分の誓約札を使い切る瞬間。犠牲は身体の損傷ではなく、燃え尽きた持ち物と決意で示す。
subject_en: One young adult man with tousled black hair, a narrow earnest face and a soot-smudged cheek, shown waist-up in a patched ivory surcoat and light blue-steel shoulder armor. He holds a small spent oath tablet on a shallow brass dish at chest height; its wax seal is blackened and its paper edge has collapsed into ash, with only a thin thread of smoke. His uninjured hands and determined eyes are the focal points, no flames on the body.
silhouette_ja: 乱れた短髪、細い肩、胸前に水平に差し出した皿。
motif_ja: 燃え尽きた誓約札、黒い封蝋、薄い煙。
background_en: A sheltered stone recess beside the archive defense gallery, muted shield arches in green-black shadow and a restrained ivory rim light; no battlefield crowd or violent spectacle.
continuity_ja: 実データのburnによるKnight支援を、使い切った物と意志の表現に置き換える。身体の焼却、追加能力、固定のアクション紋章は描かない。

name: Warden
concept_ja: 浸水区画の重い扉を管理する監守。鍵束と厚い防護襟で、戦闘員とは違う専門職の重さを出す。
subject_en: One stocky older woman with a strong broad face, a single thick grey braid and an unsmiling watchful expression, shown waist-up in a high blue-steel protective collar. She holds three large aged-brass archive keys together against her chest with one gloved hand. A folded ivory hood rests low behind the collar; strong rounded shoulders and the compact key bundle make a distinctive dense silhouette.
silhouette_ja: 厚い襟と丸い肩、大きな顔、胸元にまとまった鍵束。
motif_ja: 三本の大鍵、潮で曇る真鍮、閉鎖扉のアーチ。
background_en: A sealed flood-door chamber inside the Drowned Archive, a single massive shield-shaped doorway and a faint horizontal tide stain on the green-black wall, kept low contrast.
continuity_ja: Knightの盾アーチを建築と防護襟に広げる。鍵は職能の小道具であり、解錠システムなど新しいゲーム機能の告知にはしない。

name: Crusader
concept_ja: 嵐に削られた外郭を歩き続ける遠征騎士。旗ではなく折り畳んだ外套と携行具に旅の時間を刻む。
subject_en: One rugged adult man with a strong angular jaw, a short dark beard and a pale healed scar across one eyebrow, shown waist-up in three-quarter view. A weathered ivory half-hood frames his face above articulated blue-steel armor; he draws a rolled storm cloak tightly across one shoulder with a brass-buckled strap. The hood peak and slanted cloak roll create an asymmetrical forward-driving silhouette, with his face fully visible.
silhouette_ja: 片側だけ被るフード、斜めの外套筒、前に傾く肩。
motif_ja: 携行する嵐避け外套、層状の肩鎧、擦れた盾形バックル。
background_en: A sheltered breach in the coastal fortress, dark green stone edges and diffuse storm mist beyond, with one ivory light break behind the head; no armies or distant focal figures.
continuity_ja: Uncommonの複雑さは携行具と鎧の構造で表現する。Sentinelの豪華な装飾や紫のマントは使わない。

name: Knight Champion
concept_ja: Squireの手仕事とGuardの堅牢さを受け継ぐ合成カード。二人を重ねず、一人の完成された装備に素材の履歴を残す。
subject_en: One confident adult woman with short copper-red hair swept behind one ear, a firm oval face and a level gaze, shown waist-up standing behind a refined blue-steel shield. Its aged-brass upper arch and visibly repaired lower corner inherit the Guard's shield construction, while an ivory square-knot cord from the Squire secures the grip near her hand. Clean layered armor and a short ivory shoulder cape frame the central face and shield without royal ornament.
silhouette_ja: 片耳を出した短髪、整った台形の肩、盾アーチと結び紐。
motif_ja: Squire（1）の四角結び、Guard（2）の盾アーチと修理跡。
background_en: The meeting point of a training alcove and a gate gallery in the Drowned Archive, suggested by two shallow green-black stone planes and a narrow brass seam; simple quiet depth.
continuity_ja: 実レシピ1＋2→8を装備の継承で可視化する。人物の融合や二重の顔は避け、Legendaryとは装飾密度を分ける。

name: Vanguard
concept_ja: 仲間の先頭で進路を示す指揮役。大勢の兵や発光エフェクトを使わず、視線と差し出した手で周囲への影響を伝える。
subject_en: One imposing middle-aged woman with close-cropped ash-blonde hair, a long commanding face and a steady outward gaze, shown waist-up from a subtly low angle. She extends one blue-steel gauntlet forward at chest height in a quiet hold-and-advance signal; her other hand rests on a compact shield close to her body. Broad stepped shoulder plates and a heavy ivory sash form a strong ascending silhouette, with aged-brass trim more intricate than the common soldiers.
silhouette_ja: 短い刈り髪、段状に広がる肩当て、前に出る大きな手。
motif_ja: 道を示す手、重なる防衛アーチ、象牙色の指揮帯。
background_en: A deep archive defense gallery with receding shield-shaped arches, all empty and subdued, seafoam mist at floor level and a pale storm opening behind the upper silhouette.
continuity_ja: 他のKnightを強める実パッシブを指揮の身振りとして表す。顔を主役に保ち、追加の兵士や数値・能力ロゴを描かない。

name: Sentinel
concept_ja: 既存Sentinelの人物像を保ち、溺れた書庫を象徴する最後の守り手として描き直す。静かな正面性と緻密な鎧で最高位を示す。
subject_en: Preserve the established Sentinel identity from the existing Knight portrait: one elegant adult knight with long dark wavy hair, vivid violet eyes, silver armor with ornate aged-brass filigree, and a rich violet cape. An iconic chest-to-waist portrait with a composed frontal gaze, one gauntlet resting on a shield just below the sternum. Keep the hair shape, eye color and refined romantic illustrated facial character recognizable; the face and silver breastplate dominate the central seventy percent.
silhouette_ja: 長い波打つ黒髪、左右に張る銀鎧、落ち着いた正面像。
motif_ja: 銀と古真鍮の彫金、紫の瞳とマント、最奥の盾アーチ。
background_en: The innermost sea-facing guard chamber of the Drowned Archive, a single monumental green-black arch and a distant narrow seam of storm light; subtle ivory edge light separates dark hair from stone without creating a halo.
continuity_ja: 既存legendary/knight.jpgを人物の基準にする。紫はこのLegendaryの識別色として残し、背景と金属の経年表現でDrowned Archiveへ馴染ませる。

name: Peddler
concept_ja: 書庫の通路を行き来する年配の行商人。小さく整頓した品と温かな表情で、Merchantの生活の入口をつくる。
subject_en: One short broad older woman with a deeply lined round face, lively dark eyes and grey curls escaping an ochre headscarf, shown waist-up. A compact seaworn leather selling tray is strapped high against her body; she lifts one small aged-brass balance weight between finger and thumb. The tray has a distinctive scalloped brass corner guard and a dark stitched edge. Keep the face, hand and tray readable as one compact rounded silhouette.
silhouette_ja: 丸い顔と頭巾、丸い肩、胸前の浅い商品箱。
motif_ja: 波形の真鍮角金具、縫い目のある革箱、小さな分銅。
background_en: A sheltered market passage beneath the Drowned Archive, green-black stone and the suggestion of one folded ochre awning, with no stalls or people competing for attention.
continuity_ja: Merchantの黄土色・古真鍮・革を庶民的な道具で示す。波形の角金具をMerchant Magnate（18）の装備へ引き継ぐ。

name: Trader
concept_ja: 取引を一件ずつ確かめる実務家。行商の箱とは異なる、薄い帳簿と整った身振りを主役にする。
subject_en: One lean adult man with a narrow composed face, a long auburn ponytail and a neatly trimmed mustache, shown waist-up inspecting a closed rectangular ledger at chest height. His practical ochre waistcoat and rolled ivory sleeves are secured by a weathered leather cross-body strap. Two small linked brass sealing rings fasten the ledger, clearly visible beside his hand; the book and forearms form an orderly right-angle silhouette.
silhouette_ja: 長い結び髪、細い肩、直角に抱える薄い帳簿。
motif_ja: 対になった真鍮の封印環、四角い革帳簿、巻いた袖。
background_en: An archive counting desk beside a narrow stone window, green-black masonry, a faint seafoam reflection and a single blurred brass drawer pull; no legible writing.
continuity_ja: 取引の正確さを物の扱いで表現する。対の封印環をMerchant Magnate（18）へ継承し、通貨記号や読める帳簿文字は入れない。

name: Broker
concept_ja: 契約をつなぐ若い仲介人。鋭い横目と小さな封印具を中心に、富豪ではない仕事の緊張を描く。
subject_en: One androgynous young adult with a straight black chin-length bob, a sharp heart-shaped face and an alert sidelong glance, shown chest-up in a fitted dark-ochre jacket with an ivory neckcloth. They hold a small brass seal stamp poised above a closed leather document folio tucked against the ribs. The angular bob, narrow lapels and raised stamp create a crisp broken-zigzag silhouette; the stamp carries only a simple non-lettered geometric impression.
silhouette_ja: 黒い切り揃えたボブ、細い襟、顔の近くに上げた封印具。
motif_ja: 小さな封印スタンプ、薄い革書類入れ、鋭い折り目。
background_en: A discreet alcove in the Drowned Archive exchange hall, dark green stone, an aged-brass partition edge and soft reflected ochre lamplight; no other negotiators.
continuity_ja: Merchantの封印モチーフを専門道具として扱う。覗き見・特殊契約などの新しい能力を付与する図像にはしない。

name: Merchant
concept_ja: 重い荷を取り扱ってきた倉庫商。上等さより、太い腕と傷んだ革の実用性で存在感を出す。
subject_en: One heavyset middle-aged man with a broad nose, a full black beard streaked with grey and a patient expression, shown waist-up wearing a plain ochre coat over an ivory shirt. He braces a rolled sea-resistant leather cargo ledger across his broad forearms and checks its thick brass clasp with one thumb. A modest stitched shoulder patch and salt-whitened coat edge communicate work and weather, not nobility.
silhouette_ja: 豊かな髭、大きな胴、両腕に横たわる太い帳簿巻き。
motif_ja: 防水革の帳簿巻き、太い留め金、塩の残る上着。
background_en: A dry shelf bay above the archive's flooded storage level, green-black stone and a single indistinct sealed cargo chest behind him, with warm ivory light across the leather.
continuity_ja: Commonの生活感を守り、豪華な金鎧や玉座は避ける。商業の世界観は読めない道具と物質の質感で示す。

name: Coin Burner
concept_ja: 蓄えた価値を使い切る決断。硬貨を大量に散らさず、ひとつの消耗した取引札を静かに見せる。
subject_en: One young adult woman with copper-brown skin, one shaved temple and a thick dark braid over the opposite shoulder, shown waist-up in an ochre work vest and seaworn leather apron. With short brass tongs she holds a single charred, thin coin-shaped trade token above a small ash dish near her chest. Its stamped surface is spent and cracked, with a faint ember at the paper-fiber edge; her hands are uninjured and her expression is resolute. No melting money shower or fire magic.
silhouette_ja: 片側の刈り上げと片側の太い編み髪、胸元で向き合う火箸と小皿。
motif_ja: 焼けて消耗した円形の取引札、灰皿、短い真鍮の火箸。
background_en: A fireproof counting alcove in the Drowned Archive, black-green stone, a soot-darkened brass tray niche and muted ivory reflected light; very restrained smoke.
continuity_ja: burnによる自軍BP倍率という実能力を、価値を消費する物の表現として扱う。身体の損傷や新たな通貨・支払機能は示さない。

name: Magnifier
concept_ja: 微細な傷を見抜く鑑定の専門家。顔の近くに置く一枚の拡大鏡を、縮小してもわかる強い形にする。
subject_en: One elegant older woman with a short blunt white haircut, a fine angular face and a discerning expression, shown chest-up examining a worn brass seal through a large round handheld magnifying lens. The lens sits beside rather than over most of her face and enlarges only a small portion of one eye. Her dark-ochre high collar, ivory cuffs and articulated brass lens handle create a controlled circular focal shape inside a narrow upright silhouette.
silhouette_ja: 白い短髪、細い高襟、顔横の大きな丸レンズ。
motif_ja: 丸い鑑定レンズ、摩耗した封印、関節付きの真鍮柄。
background_en: A specialist inspection niche in the coastal archive, a small dark leather work surface and a single blurred brass lamp reflected in green-black stone; no written appraisal labels.
continuity_ja: Merchantの真鍮細工を光学道具へ展開する。カード名を視覚化するだけで、情報公開や鑑定UIなど未実装機能を主張しない。

name: Speculator
concept_ja: 不確かな海路に資本を賭ける思索家。抽象的な金融グラフではなく、重りを動かす手と考え込む目線で判断を描く。
subject_en: One slender adult man with long straight dark-brown hair loosely tied back, a prominent hooked nose and a thoughtful tired gaze, shown waist-up. In an asymmetrical ochre travel mantle over an ivory shirt, he moves one small brass weight along the arm of a compact old beam balance held close to his chest. One elbow lifts higher than the other, creating a deliberate sloping silhouette; the balance is a practical mechanical object, not a glowing symbol.
silhouette_ja: 細長い顔、緩く結んだ長髪、片上がりの肘と斜めの秤。
motif_ja: 位置を変える分銅、小さな棹秤、海路用の旅行外套。
background_en: An upper archive window overlooking indistinct storm water, green-black sill and a folded blank leather chart at the edge of the scene; no graphs, numbers or readable maps.
continuity_ja: 判断の緊張を表現し、予測市場や価格変動の新ルールを描き加えない。Legendaryの左右対称な大型天秤とは形を分ける。

name: Merchant Magnate
concept_ja: Peddlerの現場感とTraderの管理能力が一つの商いへ成長した姿。最高位のMagnateとは別人として、合成の履歴を装備に残す。
subject_en: One capable middle-aged woman with dark skin, a thick silver-streaked braided updo and a confident open expression, shown waist-up in a structured ochre leather coat with restrained brass closures. She carries a substantial closed ledger-case at chest height: its scalloped brass corner guard comes from the Peddler's tray, while two linked brass sealing rings inherit the Trader's ledger fastening. Her hand rests across both details, unifying them in one clear broad oval silhouette.
silhouette_ja: 高くまとめた編み髪、構築的な革肩、胸前の大きな帳簿箱。
motif_ja: Peddler（11）の波形角金具、Trader（12）の対の封印環。
background_en: A modest raised desk inside the Drowned Archive exchange hall, green-black stone, a horizontal brass shelf edge and one soft ivory reflection; successful but still practical surroundings.
continuity_ja: 実レシピ11＋12→18を小道具に残す。Magnate（20）の金髪・紫服・金鎧・玉座を転用せず、Uncommonとして明確に区別する。

name: Monopolist
concept_ja: 書庫の流通を一手に束ねる管理者。散らばる富ではなく、多くの封印を一つに束ねた重さで影響力を表す。
subject_en: One commanding mature woman with a severe pale face, black hair sculpted into a smooth low coil and an unreadable direct gaze, shown waist-up from a slightly low angle. A tall dark-ochre collar and layered leather shoulder mantle form a wide architectural silhouette. She holds a ring bearing several thick aged-brass warehouse seals together at her sternum; one restrained violet stone set into the central seal subtly echoes the established Magnate, without copying his costume.
silhouette_ja: 滑らかなまとめ髪、高い襟、建築のように幅広い肩、中央の封印束。
motif_ja: まとめられた倉庫の封印、重い革の肩衣、一点だけの紫石。
background_en: An imposing archive exchange vault with repeated sealed alcoves receding into green-black darkness, a thin aged-brass cornice and quiet ivory light behind the head; no subordinate figures.
continuity_ja: Magnateがプールにいる場合の実パッシブとの関係を、中央封印の小さな紫石で視覚的に結ぶ。世界観上の強制徴収など新しいルールは設定しない。

name: Magnate
concept_ja: 既存Magnateの金髪・青い瞳・紫と金の威厳を維持する。豪奢さを古びた書庫の資材に馴染ませ、商いを統べる象徴的な肖像にする。
subject_en: Preserve the existing Merchant legendary identity: one youthful adult man with voluminous swept ash-blond hair, cool blue eyes, a refined angular clean-shaven face and a controlled serious expression. He wears the recognizable high black-and-gold collar, richly ornamented golden armor with rounded broad pauldrons and violet gemstones over deep violet clothing. Show him seated in a compact waist-up portrait on a dark carved chair, one gloved hand on the armrest and a fine brass balance with two dark-violet pans beside his shoulder. Keep his face central and the balance secondary, all essential identity within the central seventy percent.
silhouette_ja: 大きく流した灰金髪、高い襟、丸く張り出す金の肩鎧、片側の細い天秤。
motif_ja: 既存の紫石と彫金鎧、紫の皿を持つ天秤、落ち着いた着座。
background_en: A solemn counting throne alcove within the Drowned Archive, green-black coastal stone, aged-brass architectural edges and a restrained warm ivory reflection. Replace the original pale decorative backdrop with quiet dark depth while retaining the character's romantic illustrated identity.
continuity_ja: 実物のlegendary/merchant.jpgを確認済み。髪形・青眼・紫服・金の高襟と大きな肩鎧・天秤を保つ。金属は古真鍮寄りに馴染ませ、既存画像の外枠や装飾罫線は焼き込まない。
